stories.headline: Apple overhauls its EU App Store fees, loosens rules for alternative app stores
stories.dek: Apple is simplifying its EU App Store fees, replacing its per-install fee with a 5% commission for apps distributed outside the App Store and making it easier for developers to operate alternative app marketplaces.
